scenes.headline: How a trellis packs a big model into 1.7 bits
scenes.sub: Mach-2 Additive Medium, a compressed Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Trellis! This model packs a hundred and twenty-five billion parameters into about twenty-seven gigabytes. Here's how.

scenes.text: Instead of rounding each weight alone, store one path through a state machine for a whole tile, and let each state emit the next weights.
scenes.mark: one path through a state machine
scenes.say: Instead of rounding each weight alone, it stores one path through a state machine for a whole tile.

steps.say: The weights are a stream of bits. A sixteen-bit window reads it, and that window is the state.
The state picks a codebook row: four small integers times a step size.
The window slides one to two bits per weight, so most of its bits carry over. Each step fills four more weights.
Signs and a Hadamard rotation are undone inside the matrix multiply, so the full matrix never exists.
This comes from a paper called QTIP. Each state in a trellis can only move to a few others.
The encoder finds the path that best matches the real weights, and stores only the path.

left.title: Routed experts
left.say: Ninety-six percent of the parameters are experts, each with its own rate, from one bit to two.

right.title: Everything else
items: Most of the bytes read per token
right.say: The attention spine stays at four bits, and it dominates what each token reads.

scenes.label: n-gram table shipped at BF16, outside the 1.7 bits
scenes.note: count it and the files are 2.74x smaller than BF16, not 9.4x
scenes.say: The headline leaves one thing out. The n-gram table ships uncompressed, at a hundred and two gigabytes.

scenes.label: Humanity's Last Exam questions right, of 2,158
scenes.note: the only gap to BF16 larger than its noise
scenes.say: Against full precision, the agentic gaps sit inside the noise. The one clear loss is a knowledge exam.

scenes.text: A trellis shrinks what you must hold far more than what you read per token.
scenes.say: So it's a capacity codec. It shrinks what you must hold far more than what each token reads.

recap: A path through states, not a code per weight
Rates per expert, from one bit to two
The n-gram table stays at BF16
scenes.say: A path, not a code per weight. A rate per expert. And a big table left alone.
